title: Unattended batch task contract
description: The durable work contract the batch coordinator loads. One batch has an ordered list of tasks; the coordinator never invents work outside this list and never performs an operation listed in forbidden_operations.

baseline_sha.description: The git SHA every task's evidence is measured against. Recorded in every state transition and in the evidence git-before/after.

mode.description: test admits the fake auditor; production refuses VERIFIED_PASS from a fake auditor.

patch_sha256.description: Optional expected hash of the change under validation; a mismatch between this and executor/patch-hash is a HOLD.

retry_limit.description: Maximum dispatch attempts per task before HOLD (retry-exhausted).

depends_on.description: Task ids that must reach VERIFIED_PASS before this task is dispatched.

approval_required.description: When true the task is held for the captain instead of dispatched.

required_tests.description: Named tests the executor command must run; fewer executed entries than this length is a HOLD.

command.description: Optional real auditor command; absent uses the built-in fake auditor (mode=test only).
